EmailTemplate.name: FTF No FAFSA on file
EmailTemplate.subject: Submit your FAFSA
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
I’m reaching out to remind you that the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) is currently available at https://fafsa.ed.gov/. I strongly encourage you to submit your FASFA to ASU as soon as possible for priority financial aid consideration. (ASU’s Federal School Code is 001081.)
ASU awarded more than $1 billion in all types of financial aid this past year. Almost everyone qualifies for some form of financial aid, regardless of their family’s income.
You can track the status of your financial aid through your My ASU page at http://my.asu.edu/ by clicking on the Finances tab. Financial Aid Notifications are released beginning in March, so you want to complete the FAFSA and any financial aid verification that may appear on your Priority Tasks list as soon as possible.
Here are some helpful links regarding the FAFSA and additional aid options:
- Financial Aid at ASU at https://students.asu.edu/financialaid/apply/freshmen - FAFSA Overview Video at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c-23SMf5DyQ&feature=youtu.be - ASU’s Scholarship Portal at https://scholarships.asu.edu/
If you have any questions about the enrollment process or ASU in general, please don't hesitate to ask. I look forward to seeing you at ASU.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
